about: Every model-calling invocation of slice 0009's proving runs, with its cost as the harness reported it (total_cost_usd). Written by scripts/prove-pattern.sh; never edited by hand. An unsettled cost counts at its ceiling.

invocations.note: harness probe, not a template run: claude -p (haiku, 1 turn) in an empty scratch dir, to learn how --resume reports cost
